name: Ernst von Delius
features: fair skin, dark blond hair, blue eyes, narrow youthful face, slim build, eager expression
bio: One of Auto Union's young hopes, promoted to the works team for 1937 after impressing in the Type C. At the German Grand Prix that July he collided with Richard Seaman at close to 250 km/h on the run to Adenau; both cars left the road and von Delius died the following day, aged 25.
